entities.name: Anyxni
entities.description: Member of the Weatherlight's cockpit crew, resilient in spirit; her head was fused into a Phyrexian tentacle.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who severed the tentacle holding Anyxni's head.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: Explored the corrupted Weatherlight with Shanna.

events.summary: Anyxni is gravely injured during the Phyrexian attack.
Shanna and Tiana explore the corrupted Weatherlight and find Anyxni's head fused into a Phyrexian tentacle.
events.quote: they discovered Anyxni's head fused into a Phyrexian tentacle.

events.summary: Shanna severs the tentacle containing Anyxni's head, ending Anyxni's torment.
events.quote: putting an end to Anyxni’s torment and freeing their spirit.

relations.quote: Anyxni was a member of the Weatherlight 's cockpit crew
